Select canonical_smiles, molecule_chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units for assay CHEMBL1217643. Join molecule_dictionary to activities on molregno, join assays on assay_id, and join compound_structures as an inner join on molregno. Filter to exact measurements where standard_relation is '=' and standard_value is not null. Do not deduplicate; return every qualifying activity row. Sort by canonical_smiles, molecule_chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, and standard_units.
